description:
FILED s473t3 (Opus triage of the 79 CATALOG-only blessed rows), on main
d9a2aac0.  PRE-EXISTING.  Probe: scratch/s473t3/probes/p05-sprintf-g.pl.

ROWS BEHIND IT (baselines/fail-baseline.tsv, 2 rows):
  sprintf.t 235  `>%.0g< >-0.0< >-0< >C99 standard mandates minus sign ...<`
  sprintf.t 237  `>%#.0g< >12345.6789< >1.e+04< >1e+04< => ...<`

TWO SHAPES (perl 5.40.3 vs ./runpcl):
  (a) NEGATIVE ZERO, row 235.  Not just `%.0g`:
        printf("%.0g|%.1g|%g", -0.0, -0.0, -0.0)
      perl: -0|-0|-0     PCL: 0|0|0
      PCL loses the sign of -0.0 in the whole float-formatting path.
  (b) `#` ALTERNATE FORM WITH `%g` AT PRECISION 0, row 237.
        printf("%#.0g|%#.0e|%#g", 12345.6789, 12345.6789, 12345.6789)
      perl: 1.e+04|1.e+04|12345.7
      PCL : 1e+04 |1.e+04|12345.7
      So `%#.0e` is RIGHT and `%#g` is RIGHT -- only `%g` at precision 0
      drops the `#` (which must keep the trailing decimal point).

Fix area: `sprintf-one`'s float arms in `cl/pcl-runtime.lisp`.

CATALOG NOTE THIS REPLACES: sweep-bug-catalog.md sprintf.t, "`%.0g` float
edges (231-237)".

FAMILY: float formatting; siblings #1476 (subnormal `%a` significand) and
#1477 (`%a` rounding at a tie).


=== ADDENDUM (s500p, 2026-09-29) — a third shape of (b), measured by the #2510 wide probe ===
`%#g` at the DEFAULT precision drops the trailing decimal point when the rounded value fills all six significant digits with the INTEGER part: printf("%#g", 233526.673484633) -> perl `233527.`, PCL `233527` (296 of 51,674 random doubles in scratch/s500p/rnd2.pl; base 209e7533 and the s500p tree print the same, so it is pre-existing and untouched by #2510).  Same fix site as (b): the `#` flag must keep the point whenever %g's fixed form has no fraction digits left.
subject: BUG (sprintf, two float edges): negative zero loses its sign in every float conversion (`%g` of -0.0 is `-0` in perl, `0` in PCL) and the `#` alternate-form flag is dropped by `%.0g` (`%#.0g` of 12345.6789 is `1.e+04` in perl, `1e+04` in PCL)
